message: No detected input validation: The code reads JSON and encoder files directly without any schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the loaded data.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local filesystem paths only; there is no remote fetch, and no checksum or integrity verification is performed on any files.

No detected label flipping detection: There is no label distribution comparison, label value validation against an expected set, or any label-noise detection tool (e.g., Cleanlab) used anywhere in the data preparation flow.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The code loads JSON files and applies encoder transforms without any outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs on the training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads pretrained models and encoder files (via joblib.load and MLFlow run checkpoints) without any hash checks, signature verification, or pinned revision controls.

No detected label distribution validation: The dataset loading and splitting code in trainer.py does not perform any class balance checks, expected-label-set validation, or anomalous sample detection before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) are imported or used anywhere in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or adversarial test routines (FGSM, PGD) are referenced anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: The test set is split from the same data pipeline with no cryptographic hashing, signing, or other isolation mechanism to prevent metric manipulation; the split is straightforward and unguarded.
No detected input sanitization: The inference path uses click CLI options and loads data directly via pandas/joblib without any shape, range, or schema validation on incoming inputs.
No detected output bounds checks: No NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or threshold validation are visible in the inference data-flow path shown in the code.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The model is a collaborative-filtering NCF recommender system (not an LLM), so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
